info.name: Agent of the Ninth Quill
info.description: The Agent of the Ninth Quill background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Skill Proficiencies: Arcana and Sleight of Hand
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Light Hammer, Thieves' Tools, Iron Spikes, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 17 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: Your sharp mind and keen burgling skills led you to fall in with the Ninth Quill, a collective of thieves, saboteurs, and spies who steal magical lore and relics from others. Through your escapades—from purloining magic items and arcane tomes to sabotaging groups of mages—you've developed cunning skills and magical tricks to further your spy craft.

setters.set: Dexterity, Intelligence, Charisma, Arcane Infiltrator Feat, Arcana and Sleight of Hand Skills, and Thieves’ Tools
